title: Teriyaki Salmon Maki
description: Cooked salmon with a reduced teriyaki glaze and crunchy cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Cut the salmon into long strips and pat dry. Cut cucumber into slim batons and pat their surfaces dry.
Pan-sear the salmon until fully cooked, then add teriyaki sauce and reduce briefly until it lightly coats the fish. Let cool to warm, not steaming.

Lay nori shiny side down on a mat; spread a thin, even layer of prepared sushi rice, leaving a bare strip at the far edge. Line up salmon and cucumber across the near third; roll firmly without crushing.
Rest the seam-side-down roll briefly, then use a damp, sharp knife to cut each into eight pieces. Sprinkle sesame over the cut pieces.
notes: No extra soy sauce is necessary if the bottled teriyaki is already seasoned.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
